about: revmoves (2026-11-20, the user: 'Ultimo dragon top turnbuckle move on a downed opponent glitches'): a handicap match, Ultimo Dragon (Revenge import 0x0376) and Kidman (0x0361) against The Rock, all CPU (two on one: The Rock is down often, so the down-target dives come). Ultimo's down-target dives (entries 261-264) done as his entry 261, 'revenge:1bc5_1bc6@12380': Revenge's own dive played on No Mercy's 12380, whose landings and miss ask the move for animations 2-4 (wrestler_state_121_125_dive_from_turnbuckle). Before the fix those were numbers past the library pair (no animation of the move); now Revenge's own 0x1BC7..0x1BC9. ('forced' counts the game's measuring of his moves at the bell too: not a sign of a dive.) Shots while he dives and the moment after. Matches one after another until the time is up ("matches": 0: a two-on-one match ends quickly); at 2x so the shots catch the dive (his first, about 25 s in, from the corner onto The Rock outside).
